# open-jev (vendored build)

Built output of [open-jev](https://github.com/nico-martin/open-jev) by Nico Martin (MIT, see LICENSE),
from the `gliner2-family` branch at commit `ec2e422` of https://github.com/shreyaskarnik/open-jev
(pull request: https://github.com/nico-martin/open-jev/pull/1), which adds the `gliner2-decide` model.

Replace with the npm package once a release includes the gliner2 family.
Rebuild: `pnpm build` in that checkout, then copy `dist/` here without source maps or the CJS build.
